itens.titulo: Jensen Huang's Nvidia Lost $200 Billion in Value After OpenAI's Revenue Run Rate Came Up $18 Billion Below Expectations. Is This AI-Jitters Sell-Off a Buying Opportunity?
itens.descricao: Jensen Huang's Nvidia Lost $200 Billion in Value After OpenAI's Revenue Run Rate Came Up $18 Billion Below Expectations. Is This AI-Jitters Sell-Off a Buying Opportunity? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Jensen Huang's Nvidia Lost $200 Billion in Value After OpenAI's Revenue Run Rate Came Up $18 Billion Below Expectations.
In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia.
For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.
OpenAI said it had a $50 billion revenue run rate, $18 billion less than the figure that was previously circulating.
Several AI stocks tanked on the news, including Nvidia, which is down 4% since the news came out.
That might not sound like a lot, but for a $5 trillion company, it translates into $200 billion.
The company's revenue growth has recently accelerated, with the top line more than doubling year over year in its fiscal 2027 second quarter (which ended July 26).
Management already provided fiscal 2028 guidance for 70% growth, which would be a serious feat given how large the company already is.

itens.titulo: De cliente a investidor: como ter Mercado Livre (MELI34) na carteira pela B3?
itens.descricao: De cliente a investidor: como ter Mercado Livre (MELI34) na carteira pela B3? Suno - Investimentos Inteligentes
trechos: Na bolsa brasileira, a porta de entrada é o MELI34, um recibo que permite acompanhar as ações da companhia com negociação em reais, sem abrir conta em uma corretora no exterior.
O MELI34 é um BDR, sigla de Brazilian Depositary Receipt, ou certificado de depósito de valores mobiliários.
No programa do Mercado Livre, essa função é exercida pelo Banco B3.
Segundo o documento do programa, 120 BDRs representam uma ação da companhia.
Cada recibo corresponde, portanto, a 1/120 da ação americana.
Como comprar Mercado Livre pela B3?
Também é necessário verificar a compatibilidade do produto com seu perfil de investidor, conforme orienta a B3.
- Acesse a plataforma de negociação e procure MELI34.

itens.titulo: Is Rare Earnings Miss Altering The Investment Case For JPMorgan Chase (JPM)?
itens.descricao: Is Rare Earnings Miss Altering The Investment Case For JPMorgan Chase (JPM)? Yahoo Finance
trechos: - JPMorgan Chase reported Q3 2026 results that missed earnings and revenue expectations for the first time in nearly three years, weighed by weaker fixed income trading and higher expenses, even as net interest income and consumer activity remained solid.
Compare how JPMorgan Chase's rare earnings miss and bond issuance stack up against other large banks by scanning our hand picked list of solid balance sheet and fundamentals (25 results).
The rare Q3 earnings miss and softer fixed income trading draw attention to how dependent near term sentiment is on capital markets activity holding up.
The cluster of recent fixed income offerings, including multiple callable unsecured notes and a completed US$3.75b fixed to floating issue due 2037, matters for the JPMorgan Chase story right now.
It shows the bank is actively issuing across maturities and structures at coupons in the mid 5% to high 6% range, while reporting higher net interest income and solid deposit trends.

JPMorgan Chase's current analyst story assumes revenues reach US$227.1b and earnings come in at US$68.8b by 2029, based on 6.8% yearly revenue growth and an earnings increase of US$5.2b from US$63.6b today.

itens.titulo: Tesla Roadster probably won't drive an earnings beat, but the big reveal did achieve 2 things
itens.descricao: Tesla Roadster probably won't drive an earnings beat, but the big reveal did achieve 2 things Yahoo Finance
trechos: The new Tesla (TSLA) Roadster probably won't be the deciding factor in the company beating on earnings when production possibly begins in 2028, but the high-profile reveal on Thursday night did achieve two things.
"Two takeaways from tonight's Roadster event.
Elon can't wait to bring $TSLA and $SPCX together," veteran tech analyst Gene Munster said in an X post.
It came nearly nine years after Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk first showed his idea for the car in 2017.
Musk said it can reach 60 mph in under a second and top 230 mph, though it is unclear whether any of the stunt features would be legal on public roads.
Tesla said production will start in 2028.
There is a $50,000 deposit on the Performance version and $250,000 on the Thrust version.
Tesla stock rose 5% in premarket trading on Friday, while SpaceX advanced 2%.
